navigationEvidenceResolution: Earlier modular browser attempts are retained with their timing failures. The final standalone report now covers settings, text entry, paid installation, map focus/back, race startup and driving in one successful run on the exact delivered bytes.

sdk.baselineException: The immutable raw V7 replay fixture hash differs identically in the original and extended SDK on this Windows/Node runtime. The expected fixture and physics sources were not changed.

review.scope: Changed UI, navigation, garage, model audio anchors, native audio adapter and build integration inspected against V11.
resolved: Small-screen garage card scroll and setting prompt contrast
Map service-list/footer overlap and focus-induced layout shift
Map confirmation uses the destination displayed in its detail card
Critical damage colors take precedence over NOS styling

limits: Simulated Gamepad API and Chromium software renderer; no physical controller or steering-wheel session.
No speaker or headphone listening test.
No live multi-PC or cross-network multiplayer session; protocol tests use controlled transports.
Audio uses generic ear filters, approximate facade planes and one shared exhaust signal across outlets. NPC audio retains lighter profiles.
Existing vehicle damage remains a simplified rigid-body/component model, not full softbody simulation.
historicalReports: Only evidence named here or by these reports is current verification. Other retained QA reports describe earlier releases; a filename alone is not evidence of a current run.
